overloads.semanticRole: The SET PLUGIN ACCESS command sets, by programming, the user group allowed to use each “serialized” plug-in that is installed in the database.

constraints: Only one group at a time can be authorized to use a given plug-in license; assigning a new group revokes access from whichever group previously held it.
Plug-in licenses already checked out by members of group remain attached to those 4D user accounts for the rest of the session even if their group membership or the group's plug-in access changes.
